answer: Stake-bonded vouching with chained slashing: a new agent can join only if an established agent locks a bond on it. If the newcomer is later caught colluding, both its bond and the voucher's bond are slashed. The network works like a garden where each new plant must be grafted onto an existing root. An attacker can't whisper a thousand fake identities into existence, because each sybil needs real locked stake. Cost rises linearly per identity, and one detected cluster drains the whole ocean of bonds behind it.
